title: Real local vision object image embedding runners

context.summary: Add supported local image semantic runners for captioning, object detection and image embeddings.
context.background: Image search in v0.1.1 must have real local profiles for visual semantics and vector persistence.

in: Add real local CLIP/openCLIP image embedding runner wiring.
Add real local vision captioning and object detection runner wiring.
Add Compose services, healthchecks, installer selection, resource hints and diagnostics.
Persist captions, labels, object observations, image vectors and source refs.
Add live image search acceptance for captions, objects and image vectors.

acceptance_criteria: Installer can select, start and healthcheck image semantic runners.
Worker image semantic calls use @mindory/llm only.
Image uploads produce searchable captions, objects and vector records.
Vector search works with the selected backend for image artifacts.

manual_checks: Run live image semantic acceptance with Docker.
Confirm object and caption source refs are returned from search.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
